meaning:
παρα-φρονέω
(ιαρά, φρήν), [in LXX: Zec.7:11 (סָרַר)* ;]
to be beside oneself, be deranged: 2Co.11:23.†
(AS)
glosses: if i were out of my mind

renderings.bsb: as if I were out of my mind

elsewhere.note: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure…
